# @chisacode/highlight

Syntax highlighting for ChisaCode terminal rendering, powered by Lezer grammars.

## Exports

- `highlightLine(line, language)` — Highlight a single line of code
- `supportedLanguages` — List of supported language identifiers
- `resolveLanguage(id)` — Resolve a language identifier to its Lezer parser

## Build

```bash
npm run build
```

## Typecheck

```bash
npm run typecheck
```

## Test

```bash
npm run test
```
